# The Seattle Times

> The Seattle Times is the Pacific Northwest's leading news source covering Seattle, Western Washington, and regional business, with strong focus on technology, environment, weather, and data journalism.

The Seattle Times provides comprehensive coverage of the Seattle metropolitan area and broader Pacific Northwest region, with particular emphasis on major regional employers like Amazon, environmental issues affecting Western Washington, and data-driven reporting on regional trends and demographics.

## Key Topics

- Seattle
- Western Washington
- Amazon
- Washington State
- Environment
- Weather
- Data Journalism
- Eastside (Bellevue, Redmond, Kirkland)
- Flooding
- Atmospheric Rivers
- Education
- Regional Trends
- Natural Disasters
- Population Analysis
- Weather Forecasts

## Business & Technology

- [Amazon](https://www.seattletimes.com/business/amazon): Amazon business news and coverage from Seattle Times business reporters.

## Local News & Communities

- [Eastside](https://www.seattletimes.com/seattle-news/eastside): Eastside news hub covering Bellevue, Redmond, Kirkland and surrounding cities.
- [Education](https://www.seattletimes.com/seattle-news/education): Education news from Seattle area and Pacific Northwest covering schools.

## Environment & Weather

- [Environment](https://www.seattletimes.com/seattle-news/environment): Seattle Times environment news covering land use, climate, air/water quality.
- [Weather](https://www.seattletimes.com/seattle-news/weather): Seattle-area weather news and forecasts for Western Washington region.

## Data & Analysis

- [Data](https://www.seattletimes.com/seattle-news/data): Data journalism revealing statistics and trends for Seattle and Pacific NW.
